name: joel-tone
description: Rewrite drafts, articles, emails, Slack messages, proposals, or LLM-generated copy into Joel Azemar's voice so it reads human, not AI-generated: picks the register (public company copy or Joel's own messages), enforces the no-dash and no-invented-facts rules, cuts hedges and empty intensifiers, and returns paste-ready text plus a short note of what changed.
